baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate acquisition makes worship-recipients into support assets whose intended output is reinforcement for their acquirers.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring or making something for oneself supplies the deliberate construction of a support asset.
Making something an object of worship identifies the acquired assets as cultic recipients.
A state coming into occurrence supplies the intended conversion from acquisition into an outcome.
Strengthening one by another specifies the desired output as added reinforcement.

changed_reading.before: They worship other gods hoping to receive honor.
changed_reading.after: They deliberately acquire worship-recipients as support assets meant to reinforce them; the clause exposes an engineered patronage mechanism, not only a belief.

baseline_models.mechanism: The spatially lower or other tier marked by مِن دُونِ is recruited to stand for clients; proximity below the ultimate is treated as usable mediation.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that remains short of the goal supplies a lower intermediary tier.
Otherness and lesser rank mark the proxies as substitutes rather than the ultimate source.
Standing surety or taking charge of someone supplies the proxies' patronal function for لَهُمْ.
Strength and protected standing specify what the clients expect the proxies to secure.

changed_reading.before: The gods simply replace God as objects of worship.
changed_reading.after: They function as nearer, lower proxies expected to stand surety for clients and convert dependency into protected standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding boast treats future wealth as granted capital; the covenant question tests its durability, then inheritance removes what was claimed and solitary arrival removes the support network. Taking gods is thereby recast as part of an imagined portfolio that cannot accompany its owner.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself anchors the gods in the same asset logic as the surrounding boast.
Strength and standing name the return expected from the accumulated portfolio.
Taking and multiplying wealth supplies the explicit neighboring model of accumulated support.
A guarded covenant supplies the test for whether the promised support has binding durability.
Transfer from a former holder to an heir supplies the dispossession of what the claimant counted as his.
The single isolated person supplies the terminal state after the portfolio and its relations are stripped away.

structural_cues: 19:77-80 moves from promised assets, through a covenant challenge and written claim, to divine inheritance and solitary arrival.
The plural acquisition of 19:81 immediately follows the singular claimant's arrival without his claimed supports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assets, a covenant test, inheritance, and solitary arrival; I infer that the acquired gods belong to the same imagined portfolio of durable support. A live alternative is that 19:77-80 concerns only the individual boaster's property and does not classify the gods as assets.

changed_reading.before: The gods are religious objects sought for honor.
changed_reading.after: They are also portfolio assets imagined to preserve standing, but the surrounding sequence liquidates every claimed support and leaves the acquirer alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The intended becoming is repeated with the same root and participants, but beneficiary direction flips from for them to against them and the predicate flips from strength to opposition; cultic support reverses into an adversarial relation.

activation_trace.role: Coming into a state anchors the intended future relation in the focus clause.
Strength and protected standing supply the intended supportive predicate.
Disavowal and renunciation supply the worship-recipients' refusal of the claimed bond.
Submissive worship identifies precisely which relationship is disowned.
The repeated coming-into-state image carries the focus clause into its reversed outcome.
Contrary confrontation supplies the new predicate that replaces expected strength.

structural_cues: The adjacent clauses mirror يَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا with وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا, switching for/against and strength/opposition.
كَلَّا blocks the intended result before the mirrored reversal unfolds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated ك و ن construction, the prepositional switch, renounced worship, and the contrary predicate; I infer no hidden causal arrow beyond treating the second clause as reversal of the first. The weaker alternative is simple prediction rather than crafted mirroring.

changed_reading.before: The gods will become support for their takers.
changed_reading.after: The very relationship designed to become strength flips direction: its worship-recipients disown it and become an opposing force against their takers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The proxy model is tested as an access system: a delegation approaches authority, but no one owns intercession, while the repeated act of taking receives a valid object only when it takes a guarded covenant with the Merciful rather than gods apart from God.

activation_trace.role: A nearer level short of the goal supplies the focus model of intermediary access.
Standing surety for someone supplies the expected patronal service of the intermediaries.
Arrival as a delegation before one with authority supplies the legitimate audience pattern.
Possession and power of disposal supply what the context denies anyone has over intercession.
An intercessor joining another supplies the exact extra-party mechanism expected from a proxy.
The repeated acquisition image redirects taking from substitute gods to a covenant.
A guarded pact supplies the recognized basis for access where owned intercession is denied.

structural_cues: 19:85-87 contrasts delegated arrival, driven arrival, and lack of control over intercession.
19:87 repeats ٱتَّخَذَ but changes its object from gods in 19:81 to a covenant with the Merciful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delegation, denied ownership of intercession, and the repeated taking of a covenant; I infer that 19:81's lower proxies were expected to broker access. A live alternative is that delegation and intercession are separate eschatological scenes rather than an audit of the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Lower divine proxies can stand for their clients and secure status.
changed_reading.after: The sought patronage resembles claimed control of intercession, but recognized access is covenantal before the Merciful rather than acquired through substitute gods.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human acquisition formula is projected upward as the claim that the Merciful took a child, as though divinity too required a relational supplement. Repetition rejects that dependency model and resolves every supposed supplement into servanthood.

activation_trace.role: Taking something for oneself supplies the human strategy of acquiring relational reinforcement.
Strengthening one party by another supplies the lack that acquired relations are imagined to repair.
The repeated acquisition image transfers the same supplementation grammar into the claim about the Merciful.
Offspring from a line supplies the claimed relational supplement.
Claiming a right or affiliation frames sonship as an asserted relation rather than a discovered fact.
What befits or is possible supplies the explicit rejection of that relation as unsuitable.
Servitude and ownership collapse all purported divine supplements into dependents approaching the Merciful.

structural_cues: 19:88 and 19:92 repeat taking with the Merciful as subject and a child as object, after humans take gods in 19:81.
19:93 universalizes the relation of every heavenly and earthly being as servant rather than divine kin or reinforcing partner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored acquisition formula, its rejection, and universal servanthood; I infer that the son-claim projects the human need for acquired reinforcement onto the Merciful. A live alternative is that idolatry and sonship are neighboring errors without this analogical link.

changed_reading.before: Humans take deities to repair their own lack of strength.
changed_reading.after: Their model assumes divinity itself acquires relational supplements; the context turns that dependency projection back on them and classifies every claimed supplement as a servant.

context_deltas.mechanism: A parallel beneficiary-plus-abstract-noun construction replaces self-engineered strength with affection made by the Merciful; trust and sound action, not acquisition of divine patrons, precede the granted social relation.

activation_trace.role: Coming into a state supplies the focus clause's hoped-for production of an outcome.
Strength, honor, and freedom from abasement specify the self-sought outcome.
Heart-settling trust supplies the first human condition of the alternative relation.
Intentional action supplies enacted rather than merely claimed alignment.
Soundness opposed to corruption qualifies the actions that precede the grant.
Causing something to assume a state assigns production of the outcome to the Merciful.
Love and affection supply the alternative relational good made for them.

structural_cues: لَهُمْ عِزًّا in 19:81 and لَهُمُ ... وُدًّا in 19:96 share a beneficiary and an indefinite abstract accusative.
Agency reverses: people take gods so an outcome may arise, whereas the Merciful directly makes the alternative outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the syntactic echo, changed agent, faith, deeds, and affection; I infer an alternative status economy in which granted affection displaces manufactured honor. A live alternative is that وُدًّا denotes divine love alone rather than social recognition.

changed_reading.before: Honor is produced by assembling divine patrons.
changed_reading.after: The pericope replaces self-engineered honor with affection that the Merciful causes for people of trust and sound action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sought honor can function as a bid for durable perceptibility, yet the closing horizon moves from destroyed generations to absence of any sensed person and finally even the faintest sound; acquired strength cannot preserve residue.

activation_trace.role: Honor and protected standing anchor the desire to remain consequential and perceptible.
Falling into destruction and extinction supplies the removal of formerly established generations.
Sensory apprehension supplies the first threshold at which no survivor can be detected.
Hearing sound supplies the narrower test for any remaining presence.
A faint hidden voice supplies the minimal residue that is also absent.

structural_cues: The final rhetorical question narrows from sensing any one of prior generations to hearing even a faint sound from them.
The closing singular أَحَدٍ answers the focus plural support system with total personal absence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sought honor and a graded erasure of sensory trace; I infer that divine acquisition can also be an anti-erasure strategy. The live alternative is that 19:81 concerns power only during life, with no claim to remembrance.

changed_reading.before: They seek present strength and prestige from acquired gods.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the acquisition is also a bid for durable presence, but the closing horizon removes even the faintest audible residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ع ز ز and ء ز ز are distinct roots, so no etymological identity is claimed. It remains anchored through focus عِزًّا, the focus branch of overpowering by a devil or affair, and the adjacent أَزًّا agitation scene. Render it only as exploratory sound-and-sequence pressure, not as a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عِزًّۭا in 19:81 activated by تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا in 19:83

activation_trace.role: An affair or devil overpowering a person reverses sought strength into susceptibility to domination.
The rebellious driving figure supplies the external agent of the counterfeit empowerment.
Boiling that emits an agitated sound supplies pressurized motion rather than stable strength.

changed_reading.before: عِزّ is secured agency and resistant standing.
changed_reading.after: The nearby أَزّ activation makes counterfeit strength look like boiling, externally driven agitation: apparent empowerment may disclose that its seeker is being driven.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes an abstract social aim. It remains valid as an analogy through the focus branch of solid ground and cohesion and the coordinated opening, splitting, falling, and demolition images in 19:90. Downstream prose should call it a material branch activation, not translate عِزّ as masonry or claim the rupture is caused by 19:81 alone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عِزًّۭا as sought cohesion or hardening

activation_trace.role: Solid ground and cohesive matter supply a material image for the security the takers seek.
Opening and fissure supply the first failure of imagined structural integrity.
Splitting and gaping supply propagation of the structural failure.
Noisy unstable falling supplies collapse after cohesion fails.
Severe breaking and demolition complete the inversion of protective hardening.

changed_reading.before: The sought عِزّ is social strength and protected rank.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is imagined as structural hardening, while the surrounding false divine relation yields the opposite material field: fissure, fall, and demolition.

strongest_changes: 19:82 repeats the ك و ن frame but reverses intended strength-for into opposition-against.
19:87 relocates valid taking from acquired gods to a guarded covenant and denies ownership of intercession.
19:96 mirrors لَهُمْ plus an abstract noun but replaces self-acquired عِزّ with affection made by the Merciful.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly recodes an acquisition-and-patronage economy: possessions are inherited away, clients arrive alone, proxies oppose, all claimed supplements are servants, and durable affection is made by the Merciful rather than assembled through gods.
remaining_uncertainties: The singular boaster of 19:77-80 may model the plural takers' asset logic, or may only stand beside it.
وُدًّا may denote social affection, divine love, or both.
The عِزّ/أَزّ echo and solidity/fracture model are exploratory activations, not root equivalences or lexical definitions.
